## Checklist
- [ ] Title in Conventional Commits form (`feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, `locale(<lang>):`)
- [ ] A line in `_Packaging/Changelog.md` under the next version, in players' words ("X now shows Y")
- [ ] New texts in `Localization/enUS.lua` below the `AUTOGENTOKEN` marker
- [ ] Tested in game on: Retail / Mists Classic / TBC Anniversary / Classic Era / WoW Forever (say which)

Krowi runs the full in-game tests (`/kevutest`) on every client before a release.
